title: Realtime Retrospective Board: AI Model Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation Artifacts
description: Dataset, scoring rubric, implementation artifacts and analysis code from a matched, replicated comparison of 90 agentic code-generation runs implementing a standardized real-time retrospective board application, evaluated across model generations (Claude Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1, Qwen), two agent harnesses (Claude Code CLI and Antigravity), reasoning-effort levels, a visual automation and testing tool (the Playwright MCP server), and a design-oriented prompt condition, with repeated runs of identical configurations. The prompt condition compares a third-party agent's system prompt, which is not included in this archive, against a one-paragraph paraphrase of its design directive written for the study, which is. Each run is scored against a 14-criterion functional rubric on a 3/2/1 scale (42-point maximum); per-run scores and the harness's end-of-session cost, time and token report are recorded in the EVALUATION_RUBRIC.md files, and every run's source, screenshots and specification are included. The analysis/ folder contains the scripts that recompute every statistic in the accompanying paper from these files, rebuild the supplemental tables, regenerate the figures, and measure the design treatment in each run's shipped source, together with the per-run visual ratings and the rating instrument. See CHANGELOG.md for version history and methodology notes.
notes: Version history, the scoring-instrument finalization (14-criterion / 42-point rubric applied uniformly to all runs) and the corrections made to earlier release notes are documented in CHANGELOG.md. The accompanying paper is under consideration at PeerJ Computer Science as an AI Application article, and an earlier version is available as arXiv:2607.02436. The third-party Antigravity system prompt used in the full design-prompt condition is not redistributed (it is excluded from every run folder and from the release archive), and only the abridged paraphrase written for the study is published, in analysis/abridged_design_prompt.md.
